name: Cline
summary: Open-source AI coding agent for the IDE and terminal.
description: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent for VS Code and the terminal, with Plan and Act modes and MCP integration for external tools. Its differentiator is transparency and model choice: developers bring their own API keys or providers and can self-host. The extension is completely free for individual developers, who only pay their model provider; team and enterprise offerings are available.

pricing.label: Free
pricing.note: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent for VS Code and the terminal, with Plan and Act modes and MCP integration for external tools.

howToUse.title: Install Cline
howToUse.description: The homepage says to install the extension in VS Code, Windsurf, JetBrains, or Cursor, or to download the desktop app for Mac, Windows, or Linux.

howToUse.title: Or use the CLI or SDK
howToUse.description: The page shows npm i -g cline for the terminal, and npm install @cline/sdk to embed the runtime.

howToUse.title: Plan, then let it edit
howToUse.description: The page says Cline plans before it acts, edits across the project, and can run bash commands.
